name: Clock Skew Causes Signed Request Rejection
description: The backup service host's system clock has drifted significantly ahead of the storage service's clock. Signed upload requests fall outside the storage service's allowed time-skew window and are rejected, even though nothing else about the request is invalid. Monitoring only detects the drift after the job has already failed.
expectedFailureSignature: storage repeatedly rejects otherwise-valid signed requests with REQUEST_TIME_TOO_SKEWED; the backup_service host's clock and the storage service's clock differ by several minutes, confirmed retroactively by a monitoring CLOCK_SKEW_DETECTED entry.
